cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad's sitting there. Can't we do this privately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He watched me blame the dog. Tell him you ate it before you tell me you're sorry.

mechanism: A coaches its former pupil apology as a performance requiring the correct audience and order, insisting confession to the witness precede sorry.
confusable: Not simply wanting an apology or more emotion: location and ordered admission determine whether A accepts it.
comparison: Spoken apology at witnessed cake table versus written apology clearing a falsely blamed sibling.
seedUse: D171 cake/table/father/dog/blame order; S05 old clear-speaking lesson.
